items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Poppa Joe Jones was incensed because of his behavior.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, he was -- he loved Max. There were a bunch of people. That's the first time I sang "Triptic" was at this festival, and we were all sick and crazy. That's true. We were in and out of the hospital. Mingus was bonkers, so was Roach. Billy Joe Jones. Poppa Joe Jones was incensed because of his behavior. So, it was like that, you know. A bunch of folks, but Roach was the -- Max was the hub or the wheel, you know. We had done something at the East 74th Street Theater, but we didn't have enough peace amongst…
I was just going to ask that.
